fusions.name: Draught Charge
fusions.desc: Rushes you to an enemy up to 6 tiles away, where the charge deals 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Not to Be Hurried
fusions.desc: Flicks a rein at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full range, and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Grazing on One Tether
fusions.desc: Restores 2 health a second to you and every ally for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Herd in Harness
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
